race.comment: NULKABA STAR (5) comes here with race fitness on his side and ready to win. Gave his all up on the speed with a tough third over 1280m at Muswellbrook on a soft (7) track. Maps well again and sure to run a big race. FIRST EMBRACE (8) Snitzel filly from Carry On Alice on debut for the Messara and Gavranich yard. Trialled well including the latest win over 900m at Muswellbrook. Ticks a few boxes from the inside gate with the blinkers going on. Go close. BANISHED (1) Hellbent colt from Defrock on debut for the Crockett stable. Trial form indicates he's up to a solid debut after winning at Scone over 1000m on July 10. Leading contender. ZO FRILLING (10) resumes after she had mixed luck last time in. Ran fourth in a recent trial over 900m at Muswellbrook. Worth thought with the claim.
